mechanism.claim: Continuation versus reversal in a volatile BTC block depends on the joint topology of direction, monotonic ordering, intrinsic-time reversals, semivariance, serial dependence, frequency allocation, and terminal range location. One fixed ridge trained only on 2021-2022 labels estimates the next eight-hour direction without OOS adaptation.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the frozen ridge prediction
mechanism.why_distinct: HVITR combines eleven scale-free price-topology features through one fixed linear shrinkage model. HVMRR used flow, basis and clock features with a six-hour label; prior handcrafted topology candidates each gated one statistic. HVITR reuses no event set, threshold, control, or OOS outcome and uses no volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset or calendar input.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: OOS trades require the causal eight-hour variation rank to be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a sparse fixed-boundary multiscale intrinsic-topology score is absent from Gross9

training_contract.label: log(exit_open/entry_open), entry=D+5m, exit=entry+8 elapsed hours
training_contract.training_rows: all source-valid decisions with finite ordered features and complete label
training_contract.standardization: population mean/std on training rows only; reject nonfinite or zero scale
training_contract.estimator: closed-form ridge with intercept, standardized features, alpha=100.0
training_contract.prediction_strength_threshold: strict empirical 0.75 quantile of absolute fitted predictions among training rows with variation_rank>=0.65

feature_contract.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
feature_contract.returns: 479 close-to-close log returns; realized variation is sqrt(sum squared returns)
feature_contract.normalized_returns: full and final-two-hour returns divided by realized variation
feature_contract.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded
feature_contract.temporal_rank_concordance: Spearman correlation of fixed minute order and 480 log-close levels
feature_contract.directional_change_densities: reversal counts divided by 478 from three close-path state machines whose fixed thresholds are 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0 times the block RMS minute return
feature_contract.semivariance_balance: (sum positive-return squares - sum negative-return squares)/sum all squares
feature_contract.absolute_return_autocorrelation: absolute lag-one Pearson correlation of absolute minute returns
feature_contract.low_frequency_share: rfft demeaned-return energy bins 1..8 divided by all positive-frequency energy

oos_clock.eligibility: source valid, variation_rank>=0.65, frozen prediction finite/nonzero, and absolute prediction >= frozen training q75
oos_clock.reservation: fixed boundaries are naturally half-open; exit first on equal open
oos_clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.oos_execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: single pre-2023 intrinsic-topology ridge specified before its labels are opened

stopping_rule: Freeze preregistration, model, OOS source support, Gross9 novelty, then strict economics; terminal first failure with no feature, alpha, threshold, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
